brief.zh: 抽打身前和身后的敌人

description.en: Wasabi Whips lash out with their flaming whips, delivering whippings to zombies both in front and behind.
description.zh: 炙热山葵挥舞火焰长鞭，抽打前后的僵尸。

chat.en: "The trick to proper whipping is all in the wrist," says Wasabi Whip. "Well, not the wrist, exactly, since I don't have any. You have to, like... BE the wrist."
chat.zh: “正确甩鞭的诀窍全在手腕上，”炙热山葵说道。“呃，严格来说也不是手腕，因为我压根没有。你得……嗯……化身成为手腕本身。”

text.en: resist cold and warms nearby plants
text.zh: 无视寒冷并温暖身边的植物
